paper.title_en: Luminosity Signatures of Dark Sector Particles from Black Hole Evaporation in Neutron Stars
paper.abstract_en: Microscopic black holes may form at the centers of neutron stars through the accumulation and collapse of dark matter. While Standard Model particles produced by Hawking evaporation are efficiently absorbed by the dense stellar medium, sufficiently weakly interacting and long-lived particles can escape and subsequently decay into high-energy neutrinos, photons, or charged particles, providing an indirect probe of Hawking radiation. We examine the joint energy--angular distribution of these secondary particles, incorporating mediator propagation, energy-dependent decay, and relativistic decay kinematics. For relativistic mediators, the normalized energy-integrated angular profile becomes approximately independent of the black hole temperature, with its characteristic extent controlled primarily by the combination $cτ_S/D$ of the mediator lifetime and source distance, as the boost enhancement of the decay length is compensated by relativistic beaming. We demonstrate the viability of this mechanism and illustrate its phenomenology with gravitationally coupled scalars, axion-like particles (ALPs), dark photons, and heavy neutral leptons. Comparing with monochromatic mediator production from dark matter annihilation, we find that the energy-integrated angular profiles can be nearly degenerate, while the energy spectra and energy-resolved angular distributions remain distinct. Although the predicted signals may lie beyond the reach of current observatories, these complementary spectral and angular signatures provide potential targets for future high-energy neutrino and gamma-ray searches.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究中子星内微型黑洞的霍金蒸发作为暗 sector 粒子的间接探针，涉及霍金辐射这一黑洞热力学核心机制；对次级粒子能量-角分布进行了含介质传播、能量依赖衰变与相对论衰变运动学的细致建模，理论深度与新颖性较好。元数据较简单（无 DOI/期刊引用），且部分信号可能超出当前观测能力，因此为中等偏上评分。
decision.title_zh: 中子星中黑洞蒸发产生的暗 sector 粒子光度学特征
decision.abstract_zh: 微观黑洞可能通过暗物质的积累与坍缩在中子星中心形成。虽然霍金蒸发产生的标准模型粒子会被致密星体介质有效吸收，但相互作用足够微弱且寿命足够长的粒子能够逃逸，并随后衰变为高能中微子、光子或带电粒子，从而为霍金辐射提供间接探针。我们研究了这些次级粒子的联合能量—角分布，纳入媒介子传播、能量依赖衰变以及相对论衰变运动学。对于相对论性媒介子，归一化能量积分角分布近似与黑洞温度无关，其特征尺度主要由媒介子寿命与源距离的组合 $c\tau_S/D$ 控制，因为衰变长度的推进增强被相对论性束流所补偿。我们论证了该机制的可行性，并以引力耦合标量、类轴子粒子（ALPs）、暗光子及重中性轻子为例展示其现象学。与暗物质湮灭产生的单色媒介子相比，我们发现能量积分角分布可能近乎简并，而能谱与能量分辨的角分布仍保持可区分。尽管所预言的信号可能超出当前观测台站的探测能力，这些互补的谱学与角分布特征为未来的高能中微子与伽马射线搜寻提供了潜在目标。
